description.value: Barside Lounge & Grill is a full-service casual dining restaurant and bar located inside Chances Casino Kamloops, offering an extensive menu of pub-style mains, handheld sandwiches, burgers, and seafood dishes. The venue supports local BC vintners by serving exclusively regional wines, and features rotating BC craft taps including Mount Begbie and The Cannery. As an amenity within a large casino complex, it provides a substantial sit-down dining option in Kamloops' north end.

The website provides a phone number (250-554-1030) not present in OSM, and confirms takeout via Skip The Dishes. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
